column2: [intro]
In the morning, I rise without a care,
No to-do list haunting me there.
I follow my heart, my own guide,
No pressures pushing from the side.
I live my life with no fixed plan,
I take each moment as it can.
Each day brings a brand-new chance,
I thrive on whims, in life's dance.
No need for a career’s design,
I chart my course, my own divine.
I dance on the edge of chance,
Laughing out loud in a joyful trance.
I’m as free as the wind’s light sway,
Keeping options open every day.
Each moment's a fresh destination,
I craft my life, a revolution in motion.
[ solo ]
I’m a butterfly flying high,
I seize each moment, reaching for the sky.
Nothing can stop me, that’s for sure,
I’m an artist, wild and pure.
[outro]
